title: KY PSC Order — Case No. 2019-00347: ELECTRONIC GRAVES COUNTY WATER DISTRICT’S UNACCOUNTED-FOR WATER LOSS REDUCTION PLAN, SURCHARGE, AND MONITORING

O R D E R 

On January 15, 2026, Graves County Water District (Graves District) filed a motion 
in Case No. 2019-00347 and Case No. 2025-000601 requesting that the Commission 
schedule an informal conference for the purpose of discussing the issues raised in Graves 
District’s application for rehearing filed in Case No. 2025-0060 on January 15, 2026. 

Having reviewed the motion and being otherwise sufficiently advised, the 
Commission finds that Graves District’s motion should be granted. A virtual informal 
conference is scheduled on January 23, 2026, at 3 p.m. Eastern Standard Time. 
Commission Staff will contact participants by electronic mail to provide details for joining 
the conference by video link. 

IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED that: 
1. 
Graves District’s motion for an informal conference is granted. 
2. 
A virtual informal conference is scheduled on January 23, 2026, at 3 p.m. 
Eastern Standard Time.
